name: pm-company-income-tax
description: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon company income tax (impot sur les societes) for 2026 under the local tax code (Code local des impots, updated to 31 December 2025). Covers liable entities, territorial profits, the 100,000 euro annual loss deduction limit, the 23% standard rate, the 15% rate on the first 42,500 euros for companies with turnover under 600,000 euros and 75% individual ownership, rounding down to 10 euros, the 500 euro annual minimum, formation notices within one month, the profit return within three months of year end, and the 15 March and 15 June instalments. Trigger phrases include Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon corporate tax, impot sur les societes SPM, IS 23% Saint-Pierre, taux reduit 15% SPM, imposition forfaitaire 500 euros.
